title: Easter Campaign Brainstorm
scope: Plan Easter dessert content for the food blog

messages.content: Easter is coming up. Let's do a dessert roundup post — something with spring vibes. Macarons, trifles, that kind of thing.

Love it. I'll put together a roundup with 5 picks — mixing difficulty levels so there's something for everyone. Lemon lavender macarons for the ambitious bakers, strawberry shortcake trifle for the easy wins. I'll have Pixel shoot a hero image with pastel styling.

Target publish date before Easter weekend?
Perfect. Publish by April 5 so people have time to shop and prep.

proposals.title: Easter Dessert Campaign
proposals.brief: Seasonal dessert roundup blog post with 5 spring picks, published before Easter weekend.
